evidence.quote: I thought this conference would be a good opportunity to share how I think about the evolution of the financial services landscape, in particular my views on de novo bank formation, or really the lack thereof.
I believe that the U.S. financial system and the U.S. banking system remain safe, sound, strong and resilient, and standing on a solid regulatory foundation.
We should support regulatory and supervisory policies that encourage prudent and appropriate de novo bank formation.

parsed.rationale: The speech focuses on bank regulation and de novo bank formation, with only a brief note on the recent bank failures and no discussion of monetary policy, inflation, or the outlook. It carries no monetary policy signal.
